title: Capability certification envelope
gap: A platform can look universal while supporting only one language and test command.
resolution: Publish per connector/language/model/tool supported versions, permitted operations, parser coverage, evaluation cohort and expiry. Unsupported requests become explicit gaps.
acceptance: Reference unsupported cases fail without silent fallback.

title: Evidence trust root
gap: A signed report can still be signed by the same compromised worker that created the artifact.
resolution: Separate workload identity, attestation verification, artifact hashing and evaluation identity. Bind evidence to exact attempt, candidate, image and test manifest.
acceptance: Forged/stale/mismatched reports cannot authorize effects.

title: Data withdrawal convergence
gap: Deleting a source can leave summaries, vectors, caches, backups and model weights carrying it.
resolution: Use a derivation registry, immediate deny tombstones, bounded purge workflow, subscriber receipts and restore-time deletion replay. Training contracts declare model withdrawal strategy.
acceptance: Deleted material is denied immediately; purge convergence and restored-copy denial are measured.

title: Control-plane bootstrap recovery
gap: Policy, KMS and directory services can become mutually dependent during a total recovery.
resolution: Maintain independently protected recovery identities, ordered restore runbooks, signed last-known-good manifests and tested key recovery.
acceptance: Cold-region restore succeeds without relying on the failed control plane.

title: Evaluator independence and capture
gap: Millions of agents can manufacture consensus through cloned reviewers or a poisoned grader.
resolution: Assign independent role slots; freeze evaluator/dataset versions; measure lineage/provider correlation; keep adversarial challenge sets and human calibration.
acceptance: Clone votes do not increase effective independence; evaluator tampering is rejected.

title: Human accountability and appeals
gap: Autonomous mistakes can leave no person responsible or no correction channel.
resolution: Every action class has accountable owner, appeal/correction workflow, understandable evidence and reversible authority. Design workforce/privacy impact review.
acceptance: A user can challenge a finding, stop a run and track resolution without exposing hidden data.

title: Supply-chain build provenance
gap: Package scripts and mutable images can subvert perfectly reviewed source.
resolution: Pin build inputs, attest builder and materials, quarantine imports, isolate approved mirrors and verify provenance before release.
acceptance: Poisoned image/package/attestation fails admission.

title: Support and incident access
gap: Enterprise isolation can be bypassed by support tooling and telemetry.
resolution: Use just-in-time scoped support sessions with owner authorization where required, dual review for sensitive access and redacted observability.
acceptance: Support access is denied without valid ticket/scope and appears in audit.

title: Independent economy and demand model
gap: ARR targets can hide free-user inference, failed-run costs, working capital and consumption workload.
resolution: Link paid execution units to actual workload, include quality-adjusted successful-task margin, customer acquisition capacity, cash collection and liabilities.
acceptance: Overage workload raises costs; cash and earned revenue reconcile separately.

title: Competitive outcome benchmark
gap: Feature count does not show a reason to switch from established tools.
resolution: Measure time to validated repair, recurrence, audit preparation, context reconstruction and total cost on matched workflows.
acceptance: A paid pilot demonstrates incremental value beyond an existing coding agent.

title: Blast-radius containment of learning
gap: A popular but incorrect lesson can propagate globally faster than it is corrected.
resolution: Limit lesson rollout by scope and rate, track affected releases, quarantine disputed knowledge and propagate signed withdrawal.
acceptance: Poisoned lesson cannot reach every tenant before detection; rollback is demonstrated.

title: Cross-cell budget conservation
gap: Parent and child workflows in separate regions can reserve the same remaining spend.
resolution: Keep a root reservation authority; transfer signed allocations with durable debit before credit and reconcile uncertain handoff.
acceptance: Network partition cannot multiply available funds or release unresolved liability.

title: Residency-local placement authority
gap: A global quorum can violate residency or block independent regional operation.
resolution: Separate global non-content locator from per-residency ownership authority. Transfer across boundaries only under explicit policy with fencing.
acceptance: Loss of another residency domain does not grant or revoke local authority incorrectly.

title: Disconnected and local mode contract
gap: Offline enterprise or desktop features can imply stale privileged authority.
resolution: Declare read-only cached mode by default; scoped expiring offline grants and local budgets are opt-in; reconcile conflicts on reconnect.
acceptance: Expired/offline credentials cannot authorize cloud effects.

title: Licensed content and export feasibility
gap: 3D/CAD datasets, proprietary sources and market feeds may forbid the proposed processing.
resolution: Registry for code/model/dataset/content/tool licenses and permitted inference/training/export. Unsupported licensed runtime stays unavailable.
acceptance: Artifact export and training check rights independently.

title: Long-lived compatibility and ownership succession
gap: Decades of jobs can outlive vendors, signatures and maintainers.
resolution: Contract deprecation windows, migration replay, cryptographic inventory, portable exports, key rotation and successor stewardship.
acceptance: Historical releases can be reconstructed and verified after provider replacement.

title: Customer concentration and provider collapse
gap: One model, cloud, customer or marketplace publisher can dominate economics and uptime.
resolution: Measure concentration; maintain tested alternatives, cash stress scenarios, model outage routing and export pathways.
acceptance: Loss of largest provider/customer has a bounded documented response.

title: Experiment interference and causal claims
gap: Concurrent repairs and business experiments confound apparent improvements.
resolution: Track assignment units, simultaneous interventions, treatment provenance, holdouts and outcomes; suspend causal claims when interference is unresolved.
acceptance: Revenue/latency attribution reports known confounders.

title: Operational readiness of the company
gap: A technical platform still fails without support, procurement, contracts and escalation coverage.
resolution: Create trust center, customer onboarding/offboarding, vendor assessment, insurance/procurement review, incident communications and support staffing.
acceptance: A real pilot rehearses escalation, export, billing dispute and incident notification.

title: Option-based future readiness
gap: No design is future-proof against AGI or paradigm shifts.
resolution: Fund reversible options with invalidation triggers; test model/tool/compiler/schema replacement instead of predicting inevitable dominance.
acceptance: Each future scenario maps to a reversible experiment and stop rule.
